The exploration is built and stopped at Phase 6 of emil-prototype, as asked. It has 4 directions (Baseline plus 3 alternatives) behind the standard picker, a scenario switcher, and live simulated delegates built from this thread's own delegation data. I flipped every variant against every scenario at both 600px and 360px in headless Chrome, and the console stayed clean. No winner is picked.

| # | Variant | Axis | When it's the right choice | Its cost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Baseline | bb's current dock, unchanged: "Running N background agents", expands to a list of description, model and elapsed time | Delegation visibility isn't worth a plugin surface yet | Shows only background agents that are still running. Foreground delegates, failures, interruptions and results never appear, it vanishes when work ends, and you can't click into anything. At 360 it breaks titles mid-word, which is bb's own behaviour. |
| 2 | Roster | Progressive disclosure: one 36px summary row (status stack, "6 subagents · 4 running · 1 failed", total elapsed) expands into one-line rows (status, title, current step or result, bg tag, elapsed) | Many delegates per turn; calm by default, detail on demand. Closest to t3code. | You can't see what anything is doing until you expand it. Expanded with 6 delegates it is about 222px tall. At 360 the step text is dropped and only "Failed" or "Stopped" words remain. The status stack is abstract because bb delegates have no avatars. |
| 3 | Rail | Horizontal chips at a constant ~34px height (status, title, timer); clicking a chip opens a preview card with what it was asked, what it's doing now or returned, counts, and "Open details" | The strip must never take vertical space from the thread; you scan names and timers, then open one | Only about 1.5 chips fit at 360. Overflow scrolls sideways, and the only hint is a cut-off chip. The preview card covers the last messages, and titles are cut to 13–20 characters. |
| 4 | Feed | Always open: each running delegate shows its current step live plus tool and token counts. A finished one stays 3.5s showing "Returned: …", then folds into a done group. | You are actively supervising multi-agent runs and want progress without clicking. Closest to the Codex app's Active/Done lists. | Tallest of the four: about 223px with 4 running (3 shown plus "+1 more running"). The step line is always moving. It depends on live per-step data, which is only confirmed for background agents. |

**Where it is**
- Prototype: `/Users/ivananchev/.bb/thread-storage/thr_gza9vveeei/visuals/subagent-strip-proto.html`. It is one self-contained file with bb's Inter font embedded. To show it in chat: `::inline-vis{source="thread-storage" file="visuals/subagent-strip-proto.html"}`.
- Picker keys: `1`–`4` or `←`/`→` switch variants, `R` (or ↻) replays the variant and restarts the scenario.
- The bar under the picker switches scenario (None yet / 1 running / 6 parallel / All done), speed (1× / 10×) and width (600 / 360). The URL keeps the state: `?v=1-4&s=none|one|busy|done&x=1|10&w=600|360`.
- Clicking any delegate in variants 2–4 opens a working stub detail sheet (prompt, status, last 5 steps, result or error). Its design was not explored.

**Screenshots** (strip plus composer, 2x, in `/Users/ivananchev/.bb/thread-storage/thr_gza9vveeei/visuals/subagent-strip-proto/`)
- At 600px, "6 parallel" with each variant's interaction open: `1-baseline.png` (expanded), `2-roster.png` (expanded), `3-rail.png` (preview open), `4-feed.png`.
- At 360px: `1-baseline-360.png`, `2-roster-360.png`, `3-rail-360.png`, `4-feed-360.png`.
- `stub-detail-sheet.png` shows the drill-in stub.

**Checked in the browser**
- Timers tick, delegates arrive, finish and fail over time, and Feed's linger-then-fold works.
- Keyboard works: arrow keys move between Rail chips and Roster/Feed rows without switching variants, Enter opens, Esc closes, and focus returns after the sheet closes.
- Reduced motion turns off the spinners, shimmer and transitions.
- No `transition: all`; the composer textarea is 16px.

**Not verified, or not real**
- **No prompt text in bb:** bb stores only the delegate's short `description`, never the prompt. The "Asked" text is the real brief for one delegate (this exploration) and reconstructed for the rest. Showing what a delegate was asked will need provider-side data.
- **Partly invented content:**
  - The 3 researchers' descriptions, step lists, results, token/tool counts and durations are real.
  - The Worker 03 result was put together from lines in the screenshot.
  - The failed fetch, the interrupted QA run, the long description and all start offsets are invented.
- **Live steps:** Feed's and Rail's current step assume child rows stream live. Context.md marks that as unconfirmed for foreground delegates; only background agents have confirmed progress events with usage.
- **Not tested inside bb:** I didn't check the page inside bb's inline-vis frame, with bb's theme tokens injected (only my dark fallbacks were exercised), in light mode, or with a screen reader or touch.
- **Baseline form mismatch:** bb's code switches the dock to its summary form at a 34rem width. The reference screenshot shows the summary form at about 561px, where the code would show a single inline row. I followed the code.
- **No dismiss:** none of the variants have a way to clear the strip once everything is settled. Clearing it on the next turn is assumed.

# t3code subagent visuals: findings

Cloned pingdotgg/t3code (shallow) to `$TMPDIR/t3/t3code`. HEAD is **337c5858**, not the 67eebac in the earlier notes, so line numbers differ from the earlier research. All paths below are under `apps/web/src/` unless noted. Nothing was run.

**Media.** t3.codes has one product screenshot and no video: https://t3.codes/_astro/app-desktop.BHuzLVLF.webp (alt text "T3 Code running Claude, Codex, Muse, and Gemini subagents in one thread"). I saved it as `/Users/ivananchev/.bb/thread-storage/thr_gza9vveeei/visuals/research/t3code/app-desktop.webp` (2880x1800, pure black dark theme). The README has no media. Nothing else on the site shows subagents. Things visible in the screenshot:
- Group header: 3 provider-logo avatars plus a "+1" chip, "**4 subagents**" in white semibold, "4 working" in small blue beneath, "25s" and a chevron at the right.
- No box or border around the header; it sits on the black canvas under a hairline divider.
- A separate dashed-circle line sits below: "Waiting on 4 subagents  <names>  **Stop**", all muted except Stop.
- A side "Lineage · 4 running" list: provider logo with a tiny blue dot at its bottom-right, white title, muted right-aligned "19s".

## 1. Group row and member rows
All in `components/chat/TimelineV2EventRow.tsx`.

**Group trigger (:95-135)**
- Layout: `flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 py-2 pr-3.25 text-left`, with no background and no border.
- Opacity: `transition-opacity hover:opacity-100`. It is `text-foreground opacity-100` when expanded or active, otherwise `text-muted-foreground opacity-55`.
- Title: `text-xs font-semibold` (12px), e.g. "4 subagents", on its own line.
- Status line: `block truncate text-3xs text-muted-foreground` (10px). It switches to `text-info` when anything is active, else `text-destructive` if anything failed.
- The status line text is `"N working · N done · N failed · N stopped · N idle"`. Order is fixed and zero counts are omitted (`packages/client-runtime/src/state/subagentDisplay.ts:25-40`).
- Elapsed: `text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums`.
- Chevron: `ChevronDownIcon size-3.5 text-muted-foreground transition-transform`, `rotate-180` when open (:128-134).

**Expanded panel (:147)**
- Container: `mt-1 mb-1 rounded-lg border border-border/60 bg-card/30 p-1`.
- `--radius` is 0.5rem, so the panel radius is 8px.

**Member row** (`components/chat/V2LifecycleRow.tsx:503-504, 468-495`)
- Row: `group/subagent flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5` (6px radius).
- Title: `text-xs font-medium text-foreground`, truncated.
- Detail line under the title: `block text-2xs leading-relaxed` (11px). Colour is `text-muted-foreground`, or `text-destructive` when failed.
- Detail text is the result when settled, otherwise progress. The generic "Child task ended with status…" is dropped, and a bare path uses MiddleTruncate (:176-183).
- Status label (e.g. "Failed"): `text-xs`, shown only if there is a detail and the status is not "completed".
- Elapsed: `text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums`.
- Trailing chevron: `ChevronRight size-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60`, turning `text-foreground` on row hover.
- Rows are two-line, so each is about 44px tall (not one line like ours).
- There is no "bg" tag.

## 2. Avatar stack
- **Stack:** `flex items-center -space-x-1.5` (6px overlap) and shows at most 3 avatars (`TimelineV2EventRow.tsx:105-120`).
- **Avatar** (`V2LifecycleRow.tsx:214-262`): `size-6` (24px) `rounded-full border border-border/70 bg-muted ring-2 ring-background`. The ring is background-coloured, which cuts a notch where avatars overlap.
- **Icon:** the provider logo at `size-3.5` (14px), or `BotIcon` as a fallback. There is no per-agent colour.
- **"+N" chip:** same size, `bg-muted text-3xs font-medium text-muted-foreground ring-2 ring-background`, and no border (`:117`).
- **Status dot** (:253-262):
  - Size and ring: `size-2` (8px) `rounded-full ring-2 ring-background`.
  - Position: `-right-px -bottom-px` (bottom-right).
  - Colours come from `STATUS_VISUALS` (`V2LifecycleRow.tsx:169-181`).
  - The dot is on member rows, but on the group stack only when there is a single agent (`:74`).
  - I found no pulse or animation on the dot.

## 3. Status language
Dot colours and labels from `V2LifecycleRow.tsx:169-181`:
- pending: info, "Queued".
- running: info, "Running".
- waiting: info, "Waiting".
- idle: `muted-foreground/50`, "Idle · resumable".
- completed: success, "Completed".
- failed: destructive, "Failed".
- cancelled and interrupted: `muted-foreground/60`, both labelled "Stopped".

Other points:
- The tooltip uses icons instead: CircleDashed for working and idle, CircleX for failed, Check for completed (`SubagentTooltipContent.tsx:112-120`). Its status text is `font-medium capitalize` in info, error, success or muted (`:154-167`).
- Running is signalled by the blue dot, the blue "N working" text, and ticking elapsed time. I found no spinner, pulse or shimmer on subagent rows.
- A shimmer does exist elsewhere. `live-tool-shine` is a 4.5rem-wide highlight sweep on transparent text, only under `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` (`index.css:551-580`, used at `TimelineWorkGroupRows.tsx:473`). The subagent rows do not use it.
- Idle dimming: a whole group that is neither active nor expanded drops to `opacity-55` and goes back to full on hover (`TimelineV2EventRow.tsx:98-102`). Failure turns only the status line red.

## 4. Motion
- **Collapse:** the subagent group opts out of animation. `<CollapsiblePanel animate={false}>` with a comment about virtualized scroll anchoring (`TimelineV2EventRow.tsx:136`), so it opens and closes instantly. The default panel animation is `transition-[height] duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none` (`components/ui/collapsible.tsx:25-31`).
- **Chevron:** `transition-transform` rotates 180°, using Tailwind's default duration and easing.
- **Rows:** there is no enter or exit animation.
- **Elapsed ticking:** `tickTextContent` writes `textContent` directly on a shared 1-second tick, so React never re-renders (`lib/tickTextContent.ts`). Formats are `45s`, `4m 05s` and `1h 02m` (`AgentElapsed.tsx:6-17`). The number is `tabular-nums` and does not animate.
- **Reduced motion:** handled via `motion-reduce` on the collapsible and the media query on the shimmer.
- **Opacity:** the 55% to 100% fade is `transition-opacity`.
- **Tooltip:** `transition-[scale,opacity]` with `scale-98` and opacity 0 at the start and end (`ui/tooltip.tsx:141`).

## 5. Hover, focus, tooltip
- **Member row hover:** `hover:bg-accent/20`, with `transition-colors` (`V2LifecycleRow.tsx:521`). `--accent` is white at 4% in dark and zinc-100 in light.
- **Focus:** `focus-visible:outline-none ring-2 ring-inset ring-ring/70`. I saw no press or scale state.
- **Group trigger hover:** it only fades to full opacity.
- **Tooltip trigger:** `delay={200}` (`:515`).
- **Tooltip popup:** `ThreadHoverCardPopup` uses the glass variant (`ThreadHoverCard.tsx:5-13`) with these properties:
  - Background and border: `dropdown-glass` is the popover colour at about 80% with `backdrop-blur(12px) saturate(1.14)` and a 1px border (`index.css:454-462`).
  - Shape and shadow: `shadow-xl shadow-black/25`, `rounded-md`, `max-w-80`, text-xs.
  - Inner padding: `px-2 py-1`.
  - Card layout: `flex flex-col gap-2 px-1 py-2`.
  - Title: `text-xs font-medium text-foreground`, truncated.
  - Body: `grid gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground`.
- **Tooltip contents** (`SubagentTooltipContent.tsx:121-187`):
  - Model line: provider icon at `size-3` with `grayscale opacity-60`, then the model label in `text-foreground/75`, then " · effort".
  - Status and time: the status icon plus word on the left and elapsed on the right.
  - Metadata rows: branch and folder, each with a `size-3` icon and a MiddleTruncate path.
  - Preview: a terminal-icon row with the last command or result preview.

## 6. Theme tokens and fonts (`index.css`)
- **Fonts:** sans is `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Inter Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui`. Mono is `ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo…` (:171-174).
- **Type scale:** 3xs = 10px, 2xs = 11px, xs = 12px (:183-186).
- **Dark theme** (:1190-1215):
  - `--background` is `#000`.
  - `--card` and `--popover` are neutral-950 at 97% mixed with white.
  - `--foreground` is neutral-100 and `--muted-foreground` is neutral-400.
  - `--border` is white at 8%, `--accent` white at 4%, and `--muted` white at 3%.
  - `--info-foreground` is blue-400, `--success-foreground` emerald-400, `--error` is red-500 at 90% mixed with white, and `--error-foreground` is red-400.
- **Light theme:** `--background` is zinc-25, `--border` is zinc-200, `--muted-foreground` is zinc-500, `--info` is blue-500, `--success` is emerald-500, and `--error` is red-500.

## 7. Named patterns
- Avatar stack with a background-coloured ring and "+N" overflow chip.
- Provider-logo avatar.
- Status dot badge: a dot in the avatar corner with a cut-out ring.
- Disclosure row: trigger plus a bordered inset panel (the "lineage list").
- Two-line list row: title above a quiet detail line.
- Ghost-dim idle: the whole row fades to 55% opacity and returns on hover.
- Tick text: elapsed time written straight to the DOM on a shared 1-second tick.
- Summary line: "N working · N done" in a state colour.
- Glass hover card.

## 8. Candidate rules
1. Chrome is almost absent: the header has no fill and no border. Only the expanded list gets a container, with a 1px border at `border/60`, `bg-card/30`, 8px radius and 4px padding.

## 1. Inventory
Source: https://www.affectui.com/components (77 listed) and https://www.affectui.com/llms.txt. The site is a JS app, so I used `/r/<slug>.json` and `llms.txt`. The 142 items in llms.txt include screens, blocks and motion effects.

Relevant to a live agent-status strip. F = free (source readable), P = Pro (source locked):
- **Agent Tree (P):** orchestrator and sub-agents as a live tree. Status, cost and time on every card, cost rolls up each branch, branches fold to one line.
- **Agent Fleet (P):** cards that sum up their sub-agents. A click opens the tree to the right.
- **Agent Findings (P):** one calm row per agent with its progress, plus findings sliding into a short feed.
- **Agent Inbox (P):** live clocks and status tags, filter tabs with rolling counts, rows that unfold and glide to their new place.
- **Agent Monitor (P):** current step with a clock, finished steps with tool logos, folds into a small bar.
- **Agent Queue, Agent Lanes, Fan-out Grid, Agent Plan, Trace Waterfall (all P):** all show live status.
- **Tool Call Card (F):** one line with live timer, status and summary. It folds open to arguments and result, and tool calls can be grouped into one summary row.
- **Thinking Loader (F):** spinner plus a shimmering label that rolls through phases and settles on a check.
- **Thinking State (P):** live timer and steps that appear one by one.
- **Button (F):** shimmering loading state.
- **Reaction Bar (F):** counts roll digit by digit.
- **Compact Breakdown (P):** rolling numbers, rows that trade places.
- **Progress Tracker (F):** checks that draw themselves.
- **Segmented Control (F):** gliding pill that stretches slightly.
- **Notification Stack (F)**, **Toaster (P):** spinner morphs to check.

## 2. How the key ones look and move
Sources: https://www.affectui.com/r/thinking-loader.json and `/r/tool-call-card.json`, `/r/button.json`, `/r/reaction-bar.json`, `/r/segmented-control.json`, `/r/progress-tracker.json`. They are files named `registry/<slug>/<slug>.tsx`.

- **Thinking Loader**
  - Pill: 34px (28px small), radius 999, 14px (13px) text.
  - Border is an inset 1px `#e7e7e7` ring plus `0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04)`. No outer border.
  - Dark: bg `#161618`, ring `rgba(255,255,255,.1)`, text `#8f8f8f`, ink `#ededed`.
  - Spinner: eight rays, `stroke-width 1.6`, round caps. Opacity cycles 1 to .18 over 800ms linear, delays staggered 100ms per ray.
  - Label change: the old label leaves over 320ms (translateY(-70%), opacity 0, blur 3px). The new one enters over 460ms from translateY(70%) with blur 3px. Both use `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`.
  - Pill width glides 460ms on the same ease; JS measures the new label first.
  - Done: spinner scales to .6 and a check stroke draws in 360ms after 120ms. The label settles on "Thought for 6s".
- **Shimmer (the key trick)**
  - An `::after` copies the text via `content: attr(data-text)`.
  - It is transparent with `background-clip:text`.
  - Gradient is `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 38%, rgba(255,255,255,.82) 50%, transparent 62%)`, size 300% 100%.
  - `background-position` runs from 100% to 0% over 1.8s linear infinite (.95 alpha in dark).
  - The sweep is a highlight on text, not a colour change. The same code is in Tool Call Card and Button (`ui-button-sweep`).
- **Tool Call Card**
  - 12px radius, inset 1px ring, 13.5px text, 12.5px status.
  - Timer is `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.
  - Status text enters over 360ms: translateY(3px), blur 2px.
  - Spinner is 800ms linear. The check draws via `stroke-dashoffset` (360ms, 80ms delay).
  - Expand uses `grid-template-rows: 0fr to 1fr` over 380ms plus opacity 240ms, chevron rotates 360ms.
  - Hover is a background tint over 160ms.
  - Error is `#c8372d` text with `rgba(200,55,45,.06)` fill and `.16` ring.
  - Group row: tool icons 24px, radius 7, overlapped -5px, each with a 2px bg-coloured ring to cut out the overlap. Icons enter with a scale .6 to 1 pop over 420ms.
- **Reaction Bar:** only changed digits re-key. Each rolls in over 400ms (translateY 70%, opacity). The container width glides 400ms on `cubic-bezier(.85,0,.15,1)`.
- **Segmented Control:** the indicator's left and right edges move separately. The edge facing the target leads, so the pill stretches and settles. Ease is `.22,1,.36,1`.
- **Progress Tracker:** the fill is `scaleX` on a transform. Springy ease `cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)` (slight overshoot) is used only here.
- **Tech:** plain CSS keyframes and transitions plus small React state, with no animation library. Everything animates opacity, transform, filter or grid-rows, all compositor-friendly.
- **Reduced motion:** every file has `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` setting animation and transition durations to 1ms and iteration to 1. Not confirmed for the Pro files.
- **Agent Fleet, Tree and Findings:** source locked. Descriptions only: costs roll up branches, findings slide in, rows glide to new places.

## 3. Visual language
- **Technique:** one ease, `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` (a quint-like ease-out), at about 360 to 460ms. Everything arrives with short translate plus a small blur (2 to 3px) plus opacity. Changes roll or morph instead of swapping. Nothing is a hard cut.
- **Colour:** nearly monochrome.
  - Light: ink `#171717`, muted `#6b6b6b`, line `#e7e7e7`, white surface.
  - Dark: `#161618` surface, `#ededed` ink, `#7c7c7c` to `#a1a1a1` muted, white at 10% for lines.
  - Colour is reserved for error and warning. Amber is mentioned for "needs you" in the Agent Graph description.
- **Texture and depth:** flat surfaces, no gradients except the text-clip shimmer and bottom fade masks. Depth is an inset 1px ring plus a 1-2px soft shadow. Radii run 12 / 8 / 7 / 5.
- **Restraint:** high. Each component has one signature motion, and the copy repeatedly says "calm". The expressive part is motion detail, not decoration.

## 4. Named patterns (affectui component)
- **Shimmer text:** Thinking Loader, Tool Call Card, Button.
- **Rolling phase label:** old rolls up and blurs out, new rolls in, pill glides to width (Thinking Loader).
- **Rolling digits:** Reaction Bar, Compact Breakdown, Agent Inbox counts.
- **Morph spinner to check:** Thinking Loader, Toaster, Approval Card ("morph into a resolved row").
- **Self-drawing check:** stroke-dashoffset (Progress Tracker, Tool Call Card).
- **Blur-in or blur-up:** `ui-tc-in`.
- **Grid-rows expand:** Tool Call Card.
- **Overlapped icon stack with cut-out ring:** Tool Call Card group.
- **Stretch-glide indicator:** Segmented Control.
- **Rows glide to their new place (layout reorder):** Agent Inbox, Compact Breakdown.
- **Costs and times roll up branches:** Agent Tree.
- **Folds into a one-line summary:** Agent Monitor, Permission Request.

## 5. License
- The 40 free items are MIT. The other 102 are Pro, a one-time purchase (llms.txt lines 5 and 11). Free items install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/<slug>.json`.
- Each item is a single `.tsx` with styles injected, and the site claims no Tailwind and no dependencies. React 19 is required.
- Copying the free ones into a bb plugin looks fine. Do not copy Pro source. I did not read the Pro licence terms.
- The patterns above are simple CSS, so reimplementing them is easy without copying.
- Not confirmed: whether the MIT notice must travel with copied files. I did not find a separate LICENSE page.

## 6. Candidate rules
1. Status changes morph, never swap: spinner becomes a check by drawing, and a row's text rolls (about 460ms in, 320ms out) instead of cutting.
2. One ease everywhere: `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`, 160ms for hover tints and 360-460ms for entrances and morphs. No springs or overshoot.
3. Every entrance is translateY 3-6px plus blur 2px plus fade. Never scale-bounce except the small icon pop (.6 to 1).
4. Running state is shown by a text-clip shimmer (1.8s linear, 38/50/62 band). Only one text line may shimmer per row, and the row summary stays still.
5. Numbers use `tabular-nums`. Elapsed time ticks in place, and changed digits roll while unchanged ones stay still.
6. Depth comes from an inset 1px ring (10% white in dark) plus at most a 1-2px shadow. No outer borders or glows.
7. The palette stays monochrome. Colour appears only on failed (red text, 6% fill, 16% ring) and needs-attention states. Running and done are ink versus muted grey.
8. The expanding list uses `grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr` (380ms) plus a chevron rotate. Rows entering or reordering glide and never jump.
9. The status stack overlaps icons by -5px, each with a 2px ring in the surface colour, and new icons pop in.
10. Reduced motion collapses all durations to about 1ms and keeps the final state. The shimmer stops, with the text colour still marking running versus done.

**Hand-off (Phase 3)**
1. It's at `::inline-vis{source="thread-storage" file="visuals/roster-lab.html"}` (file: `/Users/ivananchev/.bb/thread-storage/thr_gza9vveeei/visuals/roster-lab.html`, one self-contained 147 KB file).

**Default config** (what Save writes; seed 5 gives 3 running, 1 failed with the real git-clone error, 1 stopped, one finishing at 15s, one arriving at about 10s)
```json
{
  "seed": 5,
  "scenario": "busy",
  "speed": 1,
  "width": 600,
  "modes": { "signal": "shimmer", "accent": "blue", "row": "two", "glyph": "model" },
  "knobs": {
    "expandMs": 260, "hoverMs": 160, "morphInMs": 420, "morphOutMs": 280,
    "shimmerMs": 1800, "shimmerBand": 14,
    "stackSize": 24, "stackOverlap": 6, "dotSize": 7,
    "rowPadY": 6, "rowPadX": 8, "titleSize": 13, "detailSize": 12,
    "dimOpacity": 0.6, "ringOpacity": 0.09, "radius": 10, "accentHue": 250
  }
}
```

**Screenshots** (strip plus composer, 2×) in `/Users/ivananchev/.bb/thread-storage/thr_gza9vveeei/visuals/roster-lab/`:
- `0-lab-overview.png` (whole lab with the panel)
- `1-defaults-collapsed.png`
- `2-defaults-expanded-6-parallel.png`
- `3-m1-static-expanded.png`, `4-m1-shimmer-expanded.png`, `5-m1-spinner-expanded.png`
- `6-360-collapsed.png`, `7-360-expanded.png`

The shimmer stills were taken with the shimmer animation paused mid-sweep so the band shows. Live, it sweeps across the text.

**How it's built**
- Rules R1–R10 are fixed in the code.
- Modes M1–M4 are segmented controls.
- All 17 knobs from the list are sliders, every row always shown.
- Scenario, 1×/10× speed, 600/360 width and a System/Reduced motion switch sit in the top bar.
- What the strip shows is a pure function of the config plus simulated time. Which delegates appear, their start offsets, step timing and which ones fail all come from mulberry32 seeded by `config.seed`.
- Timers move on one shared 1s tick; only changed digits roll in the counts.

**Verified**
- Keyboard and focus:
  - Enter opens the list.
  - ArrowUp/Down moves between rows and the summary.
  - Enter on a row opens the detail stub, and Escape returns focus to the row.
  - A second Escape closes the list and returns focus to the summary.
  - Rows in the closed list can't be tabbed to.
- Status changes morph: on finish the spinner shrinks out and the check draws itself. 100 simulated seconds at 10× left no stray DOM nodes.
- Reduced motion: durations drop to 1ms, shimmer and spinners stop, and colour still marks state.
- Save inside a sandboxed iframe (the same opaque origin as bb's inline frame):
  - Clipboard is blocked, so the JSON shows in the read-only textarea, already selected.
  - Storage is blocked, so the saved rail falls back to memory.
  - The page says both of these in plain words.

**Not verified**
- Not opened inside bb's real inline-vis frame. It was tested on `file://` and in a sandboxed iframe that imitates it.
- Whether Download actually delivers a file in bb's frame is unknown. The frame probably blocks downloads; the textarea is the fallback.
- Hover states weren't tested in headless.
- Light theme wasn't checked. The shimmer highlight mixes toward white, which suits bb dark.

**Decisions to check**
- **The list expands upward**, so the summary row stays next to the composer and doesn't move under the pointer. The row order and chevron follow from that. The summary → expandable rows structure is unchanged, but this differs from the old Roster, so say if you want it reversed.
- **The two-line mode also stacks the summary**: count on top, census below, as in t3.
- **Stack glyphs:** bb delegates are all Claude, so "Model icon" is one grey Claude asterisk for every avatar. "Initial" uses the title's first letter, because `subagentType` is null on every real delegation row.
- **The stack shows the first 3 delegates in list order** (by start time) plus "+N", so the summary doesn't reshuffle when statuses change.
- **The "bg" tag is gone** from rows (R1, as t3 does); the detail stub still shows it.
- **At narrow widths** the census wraps by segment instead of dropping counts, and one-line rows hide their detail line.
- **Seeded outcomes override what really happened**, so a delegate that really succeeded can show as failed, and the reverse.

toolArgs.message:
Agent Checkpoints (affectUI) - visual and interaction notes

Pages read:
- https://www.affectui.com/components/agent-checkpoints (HTTP 200)
- https://www.affectui.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its Agent Checkpoints entry links only to the component page above. The docs index also lists https://www.affectui.com/llms-full.txt (every item's usage and props), which I did not fetch because it is not specific to this component.

Concept
- "An agent's run as a line of checkpoints, like git for agents." Rewinding to a checkpoint branches a new attempt from it. The attempt you left stays visible, faded, and reachable.
- Pro item, installed via shadcn from a registry URL. Requires React 19.

Per-checkpoint display
- Row content: title, attempt, status, and whether the row is current or "left behind". Optional small icon before the title, e.g. a logo of the tool used.
- Optional metadata on the row: time (`at`), file count (`files`), cost (`cost`). The row has a fixed height. Rewind takes the place of files and time.
- Status values: "running" (shimmers), "done" (default), "failed" (gets a badge), "stopped" (you rewound away while the agent was still working toward it).
- The head checkpoint's path is blue and everything off it fades back. Fading is described, but no duration or easing is given.
- Branching: a checkpoint whose parent already has a later child starts a new attempt "on its own lane". Lane visuals are not described further.
- Rewind button on each row. Pressing it adds a new checkpoint with the chosen one as parent and moves head there.
- No diff, restore, or collapsed-group affordances are mentioned. Only Rewind.

Layout and chrome
- A bar on top has a heading (default "Checkpoints"), a total cost (formatted, e.g. "$0.42"), and a count. The count is announced politely when it changes. An optional `task` line sits next to the title.
- The list scrolls inside the card past 14 checkpoints and keeps the current one in view.
- When narrow, the task text and file counts hide first.
- Dark mode is built in. It switches when an ancestor has class "dark" or data-theme="dark".
- The page gives no pixel values, spacing, rail or connector styling, marker shapes, or typography sizes. Those details are not on the page.

Props (from the Props table)
- checkpoints: Checkpoint[] (fields: id, title, icon?, parent?, status?, at?, files?, cost?). Pass the full array again whenever one is added or changes.
- head: string id (default: last checkpoint).
- onRewind: (checkpoint) => void.
- task: string.
- formatTime: (ms) => string (example output "0:42 / 1:05").
- formatCost: (amount) => string (default dollars, e.g. "$0.42").
- title: string (default "Checkpoints").
- className: string.

Keyboard and accessibility
- Ordered list with one tab stop. Up/Down move between checkpoints. Home/End jump to first/last. Enter or Space rewinds the focused checkpoint.
- Each row has aria-current="step" on the current one. Status is never color alone (failed has a badge, stopped is stated in text).

Motion
- Only two motion cues are described: running rows shimmer, and off-head checkpoints fade back. Nothing else is specified. Reduced motion is said to be built in across the library in the llms.txt intro, but this page does not spell out what it does for this component.

Related components named on the page: Agent Plan, Plan vs Actual, Agent Fleet, Agent Tree, Agent Ledger.

The inline row expansion is built in the lab, and the headless run passes every check with a clean console. Clicking or pressing Enter on a row now opens it in place inside the upward-opening list. The old stub detail sheet is gone, and so is the "Asked" section, because bb doesn't have the prompt. The original file is backed up at `/Users/ivananchev/.bb/thread-storage/thr_gza9vveeei/visuals/roster-lab-r2-backup.html`.

**What I borrowed from agent-checkpoints** (studied from the public preview only; I didn't request the registry source)
- A thin vertical rail with one dot per step and a hollow dot for the "earlier" node. Each step row has a fixed height, a small kind icon, and a run-relative time on the right (`0:42`, tabular).
- Failure is stated in words (`failed` next to the step), never by colour alone. The running step shimmers.
- The list scrolls inside its own box and keeps the newest step in view.
- There is one primary action per block (theirs is Rewind, ours is Open thread).
- I left out branches, attempts, rewind and per-step cost or file counts, because bb has none of these.

Notes are in `/Users/ivananchev/workspace/bb-plugins-obs/subagent-visualization/design/research-agent-checkpoints.md`. Reference screenshots are `.../visuals/research/affectui/agent-checkpoints-{page,full,card-later,card-hover}.png`.

**What the expanded row shows**
- **The row itself:** unchanged. The avatar keeps its model icon and status dot, and the chevron turns to point down. Row and body share a faint fill, and every cut-out ring takes that fill.
- **Meta line:** model · agent type · background or foreground · started time · steps. Once a delegate settles it adds "ran" time, and for background agents only, tool calls and tokens. Each item wraps as a whole.
- **Running:** the step trail is the body. The dots sit under the avatar's centre and the text lines up with the title. Commands show in mono, notes in brighter grey, and file reads, fetches and tool calls each get their own icon.
  - The last step is live: running-colour dot, shimmering text, marked as the current step for screen readers.
  - Older steps fold into "Show N earlier steps". New steps blur in, and the body stays scrolled to the bottom unless you scroll up.
- **Completed:** a "Report" header with a green dot and the end time, then the report rendered (headings, bullets, bold, code). It is clamped with a bottom fade and a "Show more / Show less" toggle.
- **Failed:** a "Failed" header with a red dot, then the error text. **Stopped:** "Stopped by you after Xm. Nothing was handed back." There are no check or x glyphs anywhere.
- **Open thread:** a light-grey filled button that stays pinned under the scroll area. A hairline appears above it when the content scrolls, and an "Esc to collapse" hint sits on the right (hidden at narrow widths).
  - In the lab it shows a toast: "would open the transcript of "…", Claude Code subagent toolu_01…". The toast's time on screen follows reading speed.
- **Keyboard:** Enter toggles a row. Tab goes from the row to Show more, then Show earlier steps, then Open thread. Esc collapses the row and returns focus to it; a second Esc closes the list. Collapsed bodies can't be tabbed into.
- **Height:** the body has a capped height with its own scroll. When a row is open, the list may grow to a share of the free thread area (never below the approved 300px). While a row opens, the list scrolls to keep it in view, never the page.

**New modes (default first)**
- Open rows: one at a time / many
- Settled body leads with: result / trail (the report becomes the last node on the rail)
- Trail: rail / plain
- Step marker: icon / verb
- Done step dot: grey / green
- Step time: since start / gap / off
- Meta: one line / grid
- Open thread placement: pinned below / above body
- Expand motion: grow / fade / none

- Expand row: 240ms (0–450); collapsing runs at 0.7×
- Body max height: 210px (140–360)
- Strip share of pane: 0.8 (0.4–0.85)
- Steps shown: 6 (3–15)
- Step row height: 24px (18–32)
- Step text: 12px (10–13)
- Result clamp: 6 lines (3–16)
- Open fill: 3% (0–8)

```json
  "seed": 5, "scenario": "busy", "speed": 1, "width": 600, "height": 640,
  "modes": { "signal": "shimmer", "accent": "blue", "row": "two", "glyph": "model",
    "expand": "one", "lead": "result", "trail": "rail", "stepLead": "icon", "stepDots": "quiet",

    "stackSize": 24, "stackOverlap": 6, "dotSize": 7, "rowAvatarSize": 22, "iconSaturation": 0.85, "discTint": 0,
    "rowPadY": 6, "rowPadX": 8, "titleSize": 13, "detailSize": 12, "dimOpacity": 0.6, "ringOpacity": 0.09, "radius": 10, "accentHue": 250,
    "rowExpandMs": 240, "maxExpandH": 210, "stripShare": 0.8, "stepsShown": 6, "stepRowH": 24, "stepSize": 12, "resultLines": 6, "openFill": 3 }

```

**Proof** (headless Chromium against the lab file; running it needed the sandbox off)
- **Running row:** steps were added live (9 to 11) and the newest is the live, shimmering step. The timer ticks.
- **One at a time:** opening a second row closes the first. Many mode holds two open, and switching back keeps only the last one.
- **Settled rows:** completed shows a clamped report with Show more, and Show less after clicking. Failed shows the error. Stopped shows its line.
- **Keyboard and stub:** Enter opens a row, Tab reaches Open thread, Enter shows the toast, and Esc collapses the row and puts focus back on it.
- **Reduced motion:** expansion takes 1ms and the shimmer stops, but rows still expand.
- **360px:** nothing in the expanded row overflows the strip.

toolArgs.message:
Research (map mode), facts only. SDK = `<repo>/node_modules/@get-bb/plugin-sdk/bundled-types/bb-plugin-sdk.d.ts`. Bundles = `<repo>/node_modules/bb-app/server/dist/builtin-plugins/provider-*/dist/host.js`. Raw dumps are in `$BB_THREAD_STORAGE/spike-generic/`: `tl_self.json`, `ev_self.json`, `scan_claude.json`, `scan_codex.json`, `codex_logs/`, `threads.json`, `events_filtered_sample.json`, `scan.py`.

## 1. SDK reachability
- **(a) Delegation rows with childRows.** `threads.timeline({threadId, includeNestedRows:"true", segmentLimit})` (SDK:18925-18928, query at 14962). Live updates come from `subscribe({event:"thread:changed", threadId})` (SDK:18005-18075), then a refetch. The `experimental_thread.events` plugin event (SDK:19506) is the server-side equivalent, debounced to 1/s. This is available on server `bb.sdk` and app `useSdk()`. I did not check that `PluginBoundThreadsArea` (SDK:22703) keeps `.events`; it is declared as `Omit<BbSdkAreas,"threads"> & ...`.
- **(b) `item/backgroundTask/*` events: reachable.** `threads.events.list({threadId, types:["item/backgroundTask/progress","item/backgroundTask/completed"], afterSeq, order, limit})` (SDK:18705-18712, 18790-18792, 18834). `ThreadEventType` includes both types (SDK:518). I verified the REST equivalent returns them: `GET /threads/thr_gza9vveeei/events?types=...` (`events_filtered_sample.json`). There is no push for individual events, only `thread:changed`. The `changed` message carries `eventTypes` and `statusChange.activity.activeBackgroundAgentCount` (SDK:517-523), so a plugin can poll `events.list` with `afterSeq` when it fires.
- Progress events carry live usage and status:
```json
{"type":"backgroundTask","id":"da3b7c4ca3-i5","taskType":"local_agent","status":"pending","taskStatus":"running","usage":{"totalTokens":99335,"toolUses":43,"durationMs":292342},"parentToolCallId":"da3b7c4ca3-i4"}
```
- `parentToolCallId` equals the delegation row's `callId`. That is the only join key.

## 2. Real status of a background Claude delegate
- **The delegation row never signals running.** In all 13 background rows scanned, `status:"completed"` and `completedAt` are the launch-ack time. `output` is "Async agent launched…" in 13 of 13.
- **Handback row.** A child `tool` row with `toolName:"SubagentHandback"` is present in 12 of 13 background rows. The one without it is the running delegate (me); its last child is `status:"pending"`.
- **Timing.** Across the 7 finished delegations in this thread, the handback `createdAt` precedes the `backgroundTask/completed` event by 5-51 ms. The delegation row's own `createdAt` and `sourceSeqEnd` advance with each child, which makes a usable heartbeat. Example for i3: launch `...621646`, handback `...874562338`, event `...874562389`.
- **Timeline top-level field.** Timeline responses carry `activeBackgroundCommands` (SDK:15585, 16279). While running, it holds a `workKind:"workflow"` row with `taskType:"local_agent"`, `taskStatus:"running"` and `usage`. It has no `parentToolCallId`, so only `description` links it to the delegation row. Finished tasks are not in `rows` (0 workflow rows).
- **Thread activity.** `bb thread list --json` shows `activity.activeBackgroundAgentCount: 1` for this thread. `GET /threads/:id` returned `activity: null`.
- **Failed or stopped agents: not observed.** The Claude status enum is `pending|running|paused|completed|failed|killed|stopped` (provider-claude-code host.js offset ~409780). `task_notification` carries `completed|failed|stopped`. I found no failed example, so whether a handback row appears in that case is unverified.

## 3. Where the result lives
- **`SubagentHandback` is Claude Code's own tool, not bb's.** There are 0 hits in `bb-app`; it is in the claude binary 2.1.318 (`var _h="SubagentHandback"`, "@internal… subagent's final report… delivered through the SubagentHandback tool").
- **`output` is the Agent tool_result text.** bb takes the `item.close` text and strips `agentId:` and `<usage>` lines (`stripClaudeAgentOutputMetadata`, `terminalToolShape`, offset ~2083700) into the delegation `summary`, which appears as the row `output`.
- **Observed on 54 Claude delegation rows across 1697 threads:** the real report is never in `output`. 37 of the 41 rows with `background:false` also have `output` starting "Async agent launched…". The other 4 have the pointer text "This agent's report was delivered to you as a message from … (its SubagentHandback call). Read it there". Every one has a handback child row with the report in `toolArgs.message`.
- So `background` (from input `run_in_background`) does not predict async behaviour in this Claude Code version. I could not check older versions, where a foreground Task result may be inline.
- The `backgroundTask/completed` event's own `summary` is the same pointer text. It also carries `outputFile`, a host-local JSONL transcript path.

## 4. Model and provider
- **Delegate model.** It is only in `presentation.detail`, as text built by `delegationPresentation`: `"general-purpose agent · model opus"`. It appears only if the caller passed the `model` input; 36 of 54 rows show no model. `activeBackgroundCommands[].model` is `null`.
- **Delegate type.** `subagentType` is `null` on all 54 rows. It is also only text in `detail` ("Explore agent").
- **Parent provider.** It is structured: the thread DTO (`GET /threads/:id`) and `bb thread list --json` both carry `providerId` (`"claude-code"`). Every Claude event row has the same value, so the icon is obtainable.

## 5. Codex
- **Two paths, both emit `type:"delegation"` with `background:false`.**
  - `collabAgentToolCall`: `childRef = receiverThreadIds[0]`, `label = prompt` (or "Spawn agent" etc.), `summary` = stringified `agentsStates` (provider-codex host.js ~567405). If there is no receiver it falls back to a plain `tool` row.
  - Tracked sub-agent: `childRef = agentThreadId`, `label = agentPath` (`buildSubAgentDelegationShape`, ~592493). Its child deltas are re-parented with `parentRef`, so they nest.
- **Every collab tool call (`spawnAgent`, `wait`, `resumeAgent`, `sendInput`, `closeAgent`) maps to a delegation row.** One logical agent can therefore produce several rows with the same `childRef`.
- **Model is not on the delegation shape.** It exists only in the tool-fallback args.
- **`childRef` is a Codex-internal thread id, not a `thr_…` id.** I found no evidence that bb creates a bb thread for it, so a plugin cannot open it.
- **No Codex sample exists.** I scanned all 38 codex threads (1735 threads total on this machine, all `claude-code` or `codex`): 0 delegation rows. The event logs show no `collabAgentToolCall` or `subAgentActivity` items. The Codex behaviour above is bundle-derived only.

## 6. ACP and Pi
- **ACP** emits delegation only for two dialects, both `background:false`:
  - Grok: the `spawn_subagent` tool, with `childRef = toolCallId` and the subagent type in `detail`.
  - Cursor: the `task` tool and the `cursor/task` client request, with `childRef = agentId ?? toolCallId` and the model in `detail` text.
  - The ACP translator sets no `parentRef`/`parentToolCallId` on items I could find, so there are no childRows. This is bundle inspection only.
- **Pi** has no delegation classifier: 0 hits for `type:"delegation"`, `subagent` or `spawn_subagent`.
- **No ACP or Pi threads exist on this machine**, so nothing is verified live.

## Quirks a plugin must handle

| Quirk | Providers | What a plugin must do | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Row `status`/`completedAt` is the launch ack, not the finish | Claude (background) | Derive done from a SubagentHandback child or `backgroundTask/completed`; running = neither | 13/13 rows; `tl_self.json` |
| Real status and usage live only in events (and in `activeBackgroundCommands` while running) | Claude | Poll `threads.events.list(types, afterSeq)` on `thread:changed`; join on `parentToolCallId == callId` | SDK:18705, `events_filtered_sample.json` |
| `activeBackgroundCommands` has no link to the delegation row | Claude | Join by `description`, or use events | `tl_self.json` |
| `background:false` rows still behave async | Claude 2.1.318 | Do not trust `background`; treat all Claude delegates as async | 37/41 async-ack |
| Result is in a handback child row, not `output` | Claude | Read `toolArgs.message` of the last `SubagentHandback` child | 54/54 |
| Model and type only as `detail` text, often absent | Claude, ACP/Cursor | Parse text or show nothing; Codex has no model field | host.js `$ae` |
| `childRef` is `toolu_…` / Codex id / ACP toolCallId, not a bb thread | all | Never open it as a thread; show the transcript from `childRows` | SDK 1686; host.js |
| Nested delegations (delegate spawning delegates) appear inside `childRows` | Claude | Walk recursively | row `i3 > i19` |
| Several rows per Codex agent (`wait`/`sendInput` etc.) | Codex | Dedupe by `childRef` | host.js ~567405 |
| No `childRows` | ACP (Grok/Cursor), probably Pi (no delegation rows) | Handle `childRows: null`; list the delegate with no transcript panel | ACP bundle |
| Failed or stopped agent behaviour | Claude | Not verified; only the enum and `task_notification` status exist | host.js ~2051453 |

Short answer on "generic": the row shape and the `thread:changed` + `threads.timeline` path are provider-neutral. Live running status, usage and the result are Claude-specific, and I could not check Codex, ACP or Pi live.

# Prior art: how each source derives delegate status, result, model and usage

Paths: `BBS` = `node_modules/bb-app/server/dist/start-server.js` and `BBA` = `node_modules/bb-app/app/dist/assets/` under the worktree. `T3` = `$TMPDIR/t3/repo` (shallow clone, MIT, T3 Tools Inc.). `T3C` = `T3/apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/Adapters/ClaudeAdapterV2.ts`.

## 1. bb core: the "Running N background agents" dock

- **What it reads.** The dock reads the timeline response's top-level `activeBackgroundCommands`, not delegation rows.
  - UI: `BBA/ThreadScreen-Cc0XfJ6N.js` `kC()` builds "Running N background agent(s)". `TC()` and `le(taskType)` decide agent versus command. `DC()` returns `e.model` for agents.
  - Schema: `BBS:25186` (`timelineWorkflowWorkRowSchema`) has `itemId, taskType, description, model, taskStatus, usage, summary, error, completedAt`. It has **no `parentToolCallId` key** in the schema.
  - Your own dump (`spike-generic/tl_self.json`) shows `{taskType:"local_agent", taskStatus:"running", model:null, usage:{totalTokens:57049, toolUses:12, durationMs:41784}, parentToolCallId:null}`.
- **How it is computed.** Server code folds `item/backgroundTask/*` events into `kind:"workflow"` messages (`BBS:67495-67517`, `applyBackgroundTaskItem`).
  - `selectActiveBackgroundCommandMessages` (`BBS:72535-72555`) keeps messages that are pending, not `skipTranscript`, not `foreground`, and whose `taskType` is `local_agent` or `local_subagent`.
  - The thread-list count uses the same rule in SQL (`BBS:46013-46052` → `activity.activeBackgroundAgentCount`).
- **Model.** `enrichBackgroundAgentModels` (`BBS:72508-72520`) takes the model from the spawning delegation message's `model` (`getBackgroundAgentModel`, `BBS:72489`). That value comes from `toolArgs.model` (`BBS` near 2745955, `getFirstStringField(toolArgs,["model"])`). Otherwise it uses the event's own `model`, otherwise the family cache. It is null in your sample.
- **Provider-neutral.** Yes. It keys on `taskType` and does not mention Claude or Codex. `grep SubagentHandback` in bb-app returns 0 hits.
- **Delegation row status.** Core never resolves it from backgroundTask events or handback. `toDelegationMessage` (`BBS` near 2746000) only merges child projections.
- **Delegation row model.** The internal message has `model`, but `timelineDelegationWorkRowSchema` (`BBS:25173-25185`) and the row builder (`BBS:74382-74401`) drop it.
- **Lifecycle rows removed from `childRows`.** `filterDelegationChildRows` (`BBS:74053-74058`) strips `workflow` rows with agent task types, so the plugin only gets handback and tool rows.
- **SDK reachability.** The type is in the SDK (`bb-plugin-sdk.d.ts:15584-15585`, `threadTimelineResponseSchema.activeBackgroundCommands`). `threads.timeline` returns it (`:18925-18928`). It is also in the read response (`:15933`, `:16279`).
  - It only lists currently-open tasks, and only for the latest page (`BBS:77360`).
  - It has no join key to the delegation row.
- **Count.** `thread:changed` carries `activeBackgroundAgentCount` (SDK `:523`).

## 2. agent-graph (`nathancolgate/bb-plugin-agent-graph`, `server.ts`)

- **Status.** `rowStatus` (`:131-145`) maps `pending` to running only if the parent thread status is in `{active,starting,pending}` (`:91`, `:626`). For a delegation (`:256-295`):
  - `childRunning = any child work row pending, OR (row.background === true && threadRunning && !handedBack)`.
  - `handedBack` means a child row with `toolName === "SubagentHandback"` exists (`:268`).
  - `completedAt` for background rows is taken from the last child (`:282`).
- **Result.** `toolArgs.message` of the handback row. Otherwise `row.output`, but only if the row is not `background` (`:271-276`).
- **Model.** None for delegations. `meta.model` is shown only for workflow agents, from `agent.model` (`:363`).
- **Usage.** Only for `workKind:"workflow"` rows, from `row.usage.totalTokens` (`:313-331`). Not for delegations.
- **Claude-specific.** Yes. The comments at `:260-266` name Claude Code's SubagentHandback. The `background` flag is trusted, which your spike says is wrong for 37 of 41 rows. It never reads `activeBackgroundCommands`.
- **Dead code.** `item/backgroundTask/progress` appears at `:104` only in a delta-event filter list.

## 3. genui (`ComicBit/bb-plugin-genui`)

- **Provider delegation rows.** Not handled. `grep delegation|backgroundTask|workKind|childRows|SubagentHandback` returns 0 hits. It only handles real bb child threads.
- **Status.** `thread.runtime.displayStatus` from `threads.list({parentThreadId})` (`project/source.ts:475,576`). Running workers come from `sdk.threads.listRunning()` grouped by `parentThreadId` (`:418-433`).
- **Latest message / result.** `sdk.threads.output({threadId})` (`:402`), cached per activity stamp. Activity time comes from the newest `threads.events.list` event (`:454`).
- **Model.** `sdk.threads.defaultExecutionOptions` (`:386`).
- **Usage.** None.
- **Provider-neutral.** Yes, but only because bb child threads exist as real threads. `childRef` is never a bb thread id for any provider (your §10).

## 4. Other plugins

- **chief-console** (`thr_3ipf4m5f5a-1/chief-console/server/live/activity-line.ts:1-15,42,143`). It reads `threads.events.list` (newest-first item events) to build a one-line activity for a child thread. Delegation is labelled "Agent" from `presentation.title` and `backgroundTask` from its title. No status or result logic. Neutral, because it works at the item-event level.
- **handoff** (`vburojevic/bb-plugin-handoff/capture.ts`). No `SubagentHandback`, `backgroundTask` or `delegation` match. The grep hit only the bundled SDK types.
- **Runtime bundles** (`~/.bb/plugins/runtime/server/*/server.cjs`). Six bundles matched my grep, but I did not read them (UNCONFIRMED); they may be bundled copies of agent-graph or the SDK.
- **workflows (builtin)** and **provider-claude-code / provider-codex**. I did not inspect these; UNCONFIRMED.

## 5. t3code (pingdotgg/t3code, MIT; `T3C` and `subagentProjection.ts`)

- **Status, Claude.** Driven by SDK system messages, not by tool-result rows.
  - `task_started` registers the node as running (`T3C:9391+`, `updateClaudeSubagentNode` at `:6685`).
  - `task_progress` sets running plus a progress string (`:9510-9531`). It is skipped for opaque background tasks.
  - `task_notification` settles the node with `claudeTaskOutcome` (`:5309`: completed, stopped→cancelled, else failed) (`:8868-8896`).
  - If the CLI process exits first, still-running nodes are marked failed or cancelled (`:8240-8275`).
  - The Agent tool_result settles a **foreground** subagent only. The comment at `:9697` says "Background Agent launches ACK immediately; only task_notification settles them" (detected by `isClaudeSubagentAsyncLaunchAck`, `:3422-3432`).
  - Background is detected via `is_backgrounded` (`:9443+`) and `backgroundedSubagentTaskIds`. It is not read from the row.
- **Result, Claude.** `task_notification.summary` for background agents (`:8888`). The tool_result text (`claudeSubagentResultText`, `:3395`) for foreground ones (`:9707`). No SubagentHandback logic: `grep SubagentHandback` in `T3C` returns 0.
- **Model, Claude.** From the Agent tool_use input `model` (`rememberClaudeSubagentLaunch`, `:4526-4541`). It is canonicalised through a model catalog, and `"inherit"` becomes the parent's model. It falls back to the owner's model for nested agents (`:9449`).
- **Usage, Claude.** `claudeWorkflowProgress.ts:68-70,177-179` maps `total_tokens`, `tool_uses`, `duration_ms` into workflow snapshots. Whether it is surfaced per plain subagent: UNCONFIRMED.
- **Fragility comments.**
  - `:3190` "Undeclared SDK field" (`parent_task_id`).
  - `:5160` "SDK: empty level can precede task_notification".
  - `:~6721` "Only task_started may reopen a terminal task id on resume; late task_progress must not."
  - `:339-340` wake-turn handling for notifications arriving after the turn ends.
  - A large wake-buffer machinery, because the notification can arrive with no active turn.
  - Roughly 12,300 lines in the adapter overall.
- **Codex adapter.** Native structured state, no inference.
  - `collabAgentToolCall.agentsStates[threadId]` maps to a status (`CodexAdapterV2.ts:3237-3260`): pendingInit→pending, running, interrupted, completed, errored→failed, shutdown→cancelled, notFound→failed.
  - `state.message` is the result (`:3258`).
  - `item.model` is the model (`:3170-3185`). Codex also reports per-turn models (`:1913-1917`).
  - `subAgentActivity` kind `completed|interrupted` also settles a node (`:3225`).
  - Subagents are real child threads (`exposesSubagentThreadIds: true`, `:300`).
- **Neutral layer.** `subagentProjection.ts` and `OrchestrationV2Subagent` (`status, result, model, progress, startedAt, completedAt`). Each adapter fills these. Provider logic sits in the adapters, not the UI.
- **Where the difference to bb plugins matters.** t3code consumes raw SDK frames (`task_started`, `task_progress`, `task_notification`) with the status/result/model semantics intact. bb plugins see only bb's already-projected rows. That projection drops the delegation row's model, never settles the row from the lifecycle events, and filters lifecycle rows out of `childRows`.

## Matrix

| Concern | bb core dock (`activeBackgroundCommands`) | agent-graph | genui / chief-console | t3code Claude | t3code Codex |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Status | `taskStatus` / `status` from `item/backgroundTask/*` events. Neutral (`taskType`). | Row status plus a SubagentHandback-child check, gated on the parent being running. Claude-specific. | bb thread `displayStatus` (genui). Item events only (chief-console). Neutral, bb threads only. | `task_started` / `task_progress` / `task_notification`, plus process-exit fallback. Claude-specific. | `agentsStates` enum. Provider-native. |
| Result | `summary` / `error` on the workflow row (background tasks only). Neutral. | Handback `toolArgs.message`. Claude-specific. | `threads.output` (genui). Neutral. | `task_notification.summary` (background); tool_result text (foreground). Claude-specific. | `state.message`. |
| Model | Spawning delegation's `toolArgs.model`, else event `model`. Neutral, null in your sample. | None for delegations. | `defaultExecutionOptions` (genui). Neutral. | Agent tool_use input `model`, catalog-canonicalised. Claude-specific. | `item.model`. |
| Usage | `usage{totalTokens,toolUses,durationMs}` on the open-task row. Neutral. | `usage.totalTokens` for workflow rows only. | None. | `claudeWorkflowProgress` maps it; per-subagent surfacing UNCONFIRMED. | UNCONFIRMED. |
